1879060164.name: Shield-smash
1879060164.desc: Strike a hard blow with your shield, interrupting enemies.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Bash or Shield-taunt.</rgb>

1879064388.name: Guide to Rivendell
1879064388.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Rivendell.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879089860.name: Guide to Evendim
1879089860.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Evendim.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879093060.name: Fowl Fleetness
1879093060.desc: A burst of speed can make the difference between freedom and flattened.

1879102532.name: Knives Out
1879102532.desc: Foregoing defence, you move your blades quicker than lightning.\n\nIncreases your melee damage and returns damage for every attack made against you, but you cannot Parry, Evade, or Block while concentrating on counter-attacks.

1879109316.name: Ambush
1879109316.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879136964.name: Ravage
1879136964.desc: Three fast attacks on your target.

1879212100.name: Grim Crystal
1879212100.desc: This crystal came from a Grim. You wonder what will happen when you crush it. You should probably crush it in the direction of someone else.

1879213892.name: A Snail out of its Shell (Melee)
1879213892.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879217092.name: Coda of Resonance
1879217092.desc:
A Finishing Skill that heals the target.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879228612.name: Virulent Poison
1879228612.desc: You spit an extremely toxic contact poison at your target that is quickly absorbed into the blood stream.

1879239236.name: Sacrifice
1879239236.desc: You are able to put yourself in harm's way and absorb all incoming damage, protecting the steed while active.

1879242308.name: Mearas-lore
1879242308.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879245636.name: Fixation of Health
1879245636.desc: Focusing on runes of longevity coupled with runes of inspiration the Rune-keeper ably inspires a friendly target. This effect can stack up to three times.

1879271748.name: Hammer Down
1879271748.desc: A devastating blow that inflicts increased critical damage.

1879290948.name: Feral Strikes
1879290948.desc: You make a pair of savage attacks, followed by a quick off-hand swipe. All blows are difficult to parry or evade.  The first attack will remove a Corruption from the target and the second and third have a chance to remove a corruption from the target.

1879302596.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Footsoldier)
1879302596.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879316164.name: Fog Frog
1879316164.desc: Summons a fog frog to help keep you company.

1879357636.name: Journey to the Hall Under the Mountain
1879357636.desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Hall Under the Mountain

1879358788.name: Goat of the Harvest Sky
1879358788.desc: A goat from the Farmers Faire.

1879362244.name: Winter Elk
1879362244.desc: An Elk from the Yule Festival.

1879368644.name: White Peacock
1879368644.desc: Brings out a white peacock to keep you company.

1879396932.name: Brown Wolf-dog
1879396932.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879411396.name: The Best Defence
1879411396.desc: Your will is an overwhelming force driving you and your companions forward to victory.

1879411780.name: Helm-crusher
1879411780.desc: A crushing head-butt that can stun an opponent into insensibility.\n\nStuns

1879451332.name: Boon of the Blackened Heart
1879451332.desc: Throw a gourd of noxious herbs at your ally, hardening their corrupt heart and making them fight with greater fury.

1879458756.name: Bow of the Righteous
1879458756.desc: Your ranged skills will restore a significant amount of power for a short time.

1879459396.name: Test Ranged Common VPS
1879459396.desc: Does fixed common damage to test buffs and mitigations.

1879484868.name: Sail to Bej Mâgha
1879484868.desc: Navigate to the fishing village of Bej Mâgha with nearby fellows.

1879489220.name: Retribution
1879489220.desc: Damages and stuns your enemy in retribution for their attacks on your companion.

1879492164.name: Scorn
1879492164.desc: Ruthlessly mock your target with heinous insults and brutal derision.

1879506628.name: Shadow Breath
1879506628.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of living shadow upon your foes.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879516868.name: Sandpiper
1879516868.desc: Summons a small wading bird to accompany you on your travels.

1879522628.name: Major Ballad - Resonance
1879522628.desc:
Heals a small area around your target while boosting your healing capability.

Ballads unlock Anthems and Codas while in combat.

<rgb=#00ffDD>While in Dissonance and Melody this skill will deal damage to a target instead of healing.</rgb>

1879526596.name: Prepared: Wisp of Shadow
1879526596.desc: Servants of the Umbral Pall use wisps of shadow to harm their enemies.
